added.summary: Any box with display: list-item is a list item: it draws a ::marker in its list-style-type, numbered by the list-item counter (CSS Lists 3 §4.6: each one increments it by 1 unless its counter-increment names list-item). An <li> is a list item through the UA sheet's li { display: list-item }, so an <li> set to another display draws no marker.
